scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.js && mise exec -- uv run --locked --python python python -B -m pytest
scripts.lint: mise exec -- ruff check skills/commit && biome lint extensions tests
scripts.typecheck: mise exec -- uv run --locked --python python ty check skills/commit
scripts.lint:fix: mise exec -- ruff check --fix skills/commit && biome lint --write extensions tests
scripts.format: biome format --write . && mise exec -- ruff format skills/commit
scripts.format:check: biome format . && mise exec -- ruff format --check skills/commit
